checks.name: B1: the row's own current claim is admitted
B1: note with the own claim passes the status rule
B1: a running row with no claim identity still refuses (a generic running status is not enough)
B1: the launch moment still refuses a running row even with the claim
B1: a foreign run_id refuses
B1: a stale (dead or reused) runner process refuses
B1: a generator cut to 60 tokens (last_run.command) refuses
B1: a run-path mismatch refuses
B1: a consumed (closed) lifecycle attempt refuses
B1: a claim whose launch is already marked refuses
B1: a prior noted attempt still refuses
reader: --report-every is the command's own value
reader: the live reading passes --live and no --end-step
reader: the final reading passes the ACTUAL --end-step and no --live
reader: the endpoint without a preserved MANIFEST is the last saved checkpoint
reader: no saved checkpoint gives no endpoint
final check: a clean final check is ok, bounded by 20 s
final check: a stop-level crossing is not ok
final check: not run while a watcher survives (one writer)
final check: not run with no time left inside the closure deadline, not ok
final check: a stop-level crossing blocks the aggregate
final check: a check that did not run (or ran out of time) blocks the aggregate
final check: an alert-only result (M3) does not block
final check: the completed trainer exit is not a liveness failure (judged by the receipt only)
